text.description_html:
AHI SIG123-203 Modern Square Stainless Steel Jordan Leverset

All stainless steel levers. Extremely resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasion making it an ideal material for door hardware. It needs little looking after and does not degrade in appearance or function with use.

*Does Not Fit standard 2-1/8" Pre-Drilled Doors. For Pre-Drilled doors Use AHI SIG123-204 Large Square Stainless Steel Leverset.

Features of AHI SIG123-203 Modern Square Stainless Steel Door Lever

  • Lever Style: SIG123 Contemporary Square
  • Rose Style: SIG203 Small European Square Rose
  • Rose Size: 50 MM Square
  • Door Thickness: Adjustable for 1-3/8" to 2" Thick Door
  • Does Not Fit standard 2-1/8" Pre-Drilled Doors
  • ADA Compliant: Meets Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)
  • Solid Stainless Steel
  • Satin Stainless Finish

Available Functions for AHI SIG123-203 Modern Small Square Stainless Steel Door Lever

  • Single Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim.
  • Double Dummy: Stationary both sides of door
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need locking.

Note: Single Dummy is Handed. All other functions are non-handed. Handing Guide
